newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila stocks end up on interest rate cut, PLDT net.
newsitem.headline: Manila stocks end up on interest rate cut, PLDT net.

text.p: Manila shares ended higher on Thursday as favourable first half earnings by Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co and a cut in overnight rates lifted market sentiment, traders said.
"PLDT's net income for the first half helped a lot along with the decision to lower the high level of interest rate which was killing everybody," Joey Roxas, president at Eagle Equities said.
The gains triggered profit-taking in midsession but the main index still managed to close 20.98 points, or 0.81 percent higher, at 2,616.40 points.
